note: Orders to walk into a room that a crew member will not take, because of what they remember (S2.10, moved into content in S3.3; D-102, D-110). Tried in `order`; the first that fits is the reason shown. $crew is who was ordered, $room is where. Every rule has a way round it that is itself play: a suit, a lamp, a crewmate, someone else, or time.

items.note: Where a crewmate died, while whatever is wrong in there is still wrong.
items.reason: {crew} won't go back into {room}. Not after what happened to {memory.who}.
{crew} won't walk into the fire in {room} without a suit. Not after the burns from {memory.room}.
{crew} won't go into {room} without a suit. Not after running out of air in {memory.room}.

items.note: An unlit room with none of ours in it, for anyone with a bad memory of the dark.
items.reason: {crew} won't go into {room} alone in the dark. Not after {memory.shadow}.

items.note: A big fire or an airless room, unsuited, on the word of a captain they watched override Margo.
items.reason: {crew} won't walk into {room} on the captain's word. Not after the captain overrode Margo over {memory.room}.
